name: background-color
description: Sets Claude's background color for light mode and dark mode, with cards, panels and text tuned to match.

enabled.title: Custom background
enabled.description: Paint the background colors below. Off leaves the app's own look.

lightBackground.title: Light mode background
lightBackground.description: Hex color for the page in light mode, such as #f3efe6. Leave blank for the mod's default.

darkBackground.title: Dark mode background
darkBackground.description: Hex color for the page in dark mode, such as #1b1d22. Leave blank for the mod's default.
